positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- TypeScript, React, React Router framework mode, react-hook-form
- Styled Components, CSS modules, Storybook, Chromatic
- Mirage, Mock Service Worker (MSW), OpenAPI, gRPC
- Vitest, Jest, @testing-library, Playwright, Cypress
- Figma, Sentry, Datadog

- I brought modern frontend expertise to a backend-focused product engineering team
- I maintained exceptional output and technical quality through multiple reorgs and shifting product priorities
- I strengthened web practices and raised the bar for web engineering on my newly created web team and organization

Square Payroll modernization project (TypeScript, React, OpenAPI)
- I rearchitected and rewrote the UI flow that moves $7 billion in wages for 70,000 employers and 200,000 employees every year
	- I worked on this project for 14 months alongside 7 backend engineers, 1 product manager, and 1 designer
- I wrote Engineering Design Documents (EDDs) for multiple milestones
- I designed API contracts and provided input on backend engineers' API contracts
- I cut input latency for the MoneyField component from 1200ms to 100ms on older devices
- I mentored backend engineers through their first modern React contributions

Square Staff Tips modernization project (React Router v7 Framework Mode, React Query)
- I rewrote the UI flow that controls how $7 billion in tips are distributed to employees
	- I worked on this project for 7 months alongside 1 frontend engineer, 1 product manager, 1 product designer, 1 content designer, and 1 UX researcher
- I translated 70 Figma frames into 90 Jira tickets
- I created proof of concept PRs to accelerate the team's learnings
- I drove alignment in engineering sequencing and timelines when the project's UI designs were remade

Ask me about the SEVs I've been a part of or other non-project things I've done!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- React.js (hooks),  Styled Components, a11y, deck.gl, Figma, GraphQL (Apollo), Node.js (Meteor), MongoDB, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Cypress

- I wrote all of our team's downtime post mortems and shared them with our non-technical stakeholders.
- I created the first iteration of a new referral program at fly.surfair.com/refer with Marketing, Sales, and Design. I assumed the roles of PM and QA when the project's momentum began stalling. I delivered pixel perfect implementations of Design Team's Figmas when appropriate.

- I created intuitive UIs for our internal dashboard so that no additional special training is required of new employees.
- I debugged React.js/DOM performance issues that were causing < 60 FPS interactions.
- I made our flagship Flight Search component reusable in multiple codebases.

- I monitored Node.js and MongoDB clusters for stability under 10x our usual traffic.
- I reduced the frequency of emergency intervention of mission critical cron jobs by 95%.
- I automated manual work for customer bookings via API integrations with undocumented legacy systems.
- I eliminated redundant work from our largest flight synchronization pipeline. This work reduced our machine's workload by 50% and, more importantly, eliminated the need for cross-team debugging with our contractors.
- I reduced replication latency between our legacy and modern systems from 90 minutes to 15 seconds.
- I discovered and corrected the underpricing of 15% of our inventory.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineering Instructor
positions.description:
- I trained hundreds of full stack software engineers every year. I gave 1000 workshops and lectures about advanced JavaScript fundamentals, including callback continuation style, Promises, async/await, and observables. I mentored engineers through identifying bottlenecks and scaling Node.js services on AWS EC2 instances for 10MM+ database records.
- I built technical tools and non-technical processes that are adopted by other campuses.
- I designed and implemented curriculum and infrastructure improvements.
- I managed and supported 6 full-time staff members and 8 teaching assistants at our network's flagship remote campus.
- I coordinated with 50 stakeholders over 3 months to simultaneously migrate every campus to our new online curriculum platform.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Economics with Distinction; Minors in Accounting and Mathematics
